title: Yuru language
description: Extinct Australian Aboriginal language of Queensland
extract: Yuru (Juru) is an extinct Australian Aboriginal language formerly spoken at the mouth of the Burdekin River in the state of Queensland. A single vocabulary collected by John O'Connor and published in The Australian Race by Edward Curr is the only source on the language.
